Burkett]], with interior art by [[Frank Boyd Forney]]. It is the first installment of the book series ''[[Star Wars Science Adventures]]'', and it was published in [[February]] [[1999]] by [[Scholastic]]. A sequel, ''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]'', was also published. ''Emergency in Escape Pod Four'' is set in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], and it introduces the young [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Stuart Zissu]] and the [[Science research droid|research droid]] [[4B-X]] as they go on an adventure with the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The book also includes several activities which demonstrate physics from the story.
